basic_details.job_title: ICDS Buxar Lady Supervisor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 22 Posts
basic_details.application_mode: Online (followed by submission of hard copy by registered post)
basic_details.short_information: Integrated Child Development Services, Buxar (ICDS Buxar) has announced 22 vacancies for Lady Supervisor posts on a contract basis under advertisement number 01/2026. Applicants for these positions in Buxar must possess a Matric or equivalent qualification and 10 years of experience as an Anganwadi Sevika, with a pay of Rs. 25,000 per month. Candidates can submit their online application from 21 October 2026 to 19 November 2026. Additionally, applicants must send the printout of the submitted online application form along with required certificates by registered post on or before 19 November 2

selection_process: Selection for the Lady Supervisor post is based on a merit list prepared according to the marks obtained in educational qualifications (Matric

and postgraduate exams) and bonus marks assigned for continuous service. Bonus marks are awarded at the rate of 1 mark for each completed year of continuous service as an Anganwadi Sevika up to a maximum of 10 years (10 marks). Additional bonus marks are granted for national or state awards received as an Anganwadi Sevika
and post-graduation) and academic achievements for candidates with National/State awards
subject to prior official departmental permission for acquiring higher qualifications. Final selection excludes candidates with adverse records or disciplinary action.
how_to_apply: Visit the official district website at buxar.nic.in or the portal at 125.16.175.140:88/VacancyList.aspx to access the online application form.
Complete the online registration and fill out all required details accurately on the portal before 19.11.2026 (05:00 PM).
Take two hard copies of the successfully submitted online application form.

Enclose self-attested copies of required documents including marksheets, certificates, caste certificate, residential certificate, character certificate issued by a gazetted officer, and experience certificate countersigned by the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO).
Write "Application for Lady Supervisor post under Anganwadi Sevika" prominently on the top of the envelope.

Send the application by registered post only to the office of the District Programme Officer, Buxar so that it reaches on or before 19.11.2026 by 05:00 PM. Hand-delivered applications or submissions through normal post will not be accepted.
important_instructions: Only working Anganwadi Sevikas of Buxar district with at least 10 years of service as of 01.01.2026 are eligible to apply. The application must be submitted online and a printed hard copy along with all mandatory enclosures must be sent via registered post. Applications received after the final closing date (19.11.2026, 05:00 PM) or sent by normal post or delivered by hand will be rejected summarily. Candidates must bring the original registered postal receipt for verification during counselling. The fixed monthly honorarium/remuneration for the Lady Supervisor post is Rs. 25,000, along with an additional Rs. 120 per month as Anganwadi Centre travel allowance (maximum Rs. 9,000 per month). Selected candidates must submit a medical fitness certificate issued by the Civil Surgeon before final appointment. Engagement is purely on a contract basis under departmental guidelines, and candidates cannot claim regular appointment.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be working Anganwadi Sevikas under Samagra Bal Vikas Seva Yojna within Buxar district. Candidates must be permanent residents of Buxar district. The educational qualification required is Matriculation or an equivalent examination pass. Candidates must have completed 10 years of continuous service as an Anganwadi Sevika as of 01.01.2026. The upper age limit is 45 years as of 01.01.2026, with an 11-year relaxation in the upper age limit. Female candidates belonging to respective reserved categories must possess valid supporting certificates such as caste certificates, creamy layer exemption certificates for backward classes issued by competent authorities, and residential certificates.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the Lady Supervisor post is based on a merit list prepared according to the marks obtained in educational qualifications (Matric, Intermediate, graduation, and postgraduate exams) and bonus marks assigned for continuous service. Bonus marks are awarded at the rate of 1 mark for each completed year of continuous service as an Anganwadi Sevika up to a maximum of 10 years (10 marks). Additional bonus marks are granted for national or state awards received as an Anganwadi Sevika, and for higher educational degrees (intermediate, graduation, and post-graduation) and academic achievements for candidates with National/State awards, subject to prior official departmental permission for acquiring higher qualifications. Final selection excludes candidates with adverse records or disciplinary action.

content_sections.heading: ICDS Buxar Lady Supervisor Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Lady Supervisor works on a contract basis under the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) program within Buxar district, supervising Anganwadi centres, monitoring nutrition and health schemes, and coordinating grassroots implementation as per the guidelines of the Directorate of ICDS, Bihar, Patna.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICDS Buxar Lady Supervisor
content_sections.text: Visit the official district website at buxar.nic.in or the portal at 125.16.175.140:88/VacancyList.aspx to access the online application form. Complete the online registration and fill out all required details accurately on the portal before 19.11.2026 (05:00 PM). Take two hard copies of the successfully submitted online application form. Enclose self-attested copies of required documents including marksheets, certificates, caste certificate, residential certificate, character certificate issued by a gazetted officer, and experience certificate countersigned by the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO). Write "Application for Lady Supervisor post under Anganwadi Sevika" prominently on the top of the envelope. Send the application by registered post only to the office of the District Programme Officer, Buxar so that it reaches on or before 19.11.2026 by 05:00 PM. Hand-delivered applications or submissions through normal post will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation (10th) marksheet and pass certificate for date of birth and educational verification Certificates and marksheets for Intermediate, Graduation, and Post-Graduation qualifications (if applicable) Residential certificate issued by the Sub-Divisional Officer (Anumandal Padadhikari) Character certificate issued by a Gazetted Officer Caste certificate and EWS/Creamy Layer exemption certificate for reserved categories issued by competent authorities Experience certificate showing years of service as an Anganwadi Sevika, issued and countersigned by the concerned Child Development Project Officer (CDPO), specifying the exact years National or State Award certificate (if awarded to the Anganwadi Sevika) Other relevant documents like disability certificates, if applicable

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only working Anganwadi Sevikas of Buxar district with at least 10 years of service as of 01.01.2026 are eligible to apply. The application must be submitted online and a printed hard copy along with all mandatory enclosures must be sent via registered post. Applications received after the final closing date (19.11.2026, 05:00 PM) or sent by normal post or delivered by hand will be rejected summarily. Candidates must bring the original registered postal receipt for verification during counselling. The fixed monthly honorarium/remuneration for the Lady Supervisor post is Rs. 25,000, along with an additional Rs. 120 per month as Anganwadi Centre travel allowance (maximum Rs. 9,000 per month). Selected candidates must submit a medical fitness certificate issued by the Civil Surgeon before final appointment. Engagement is purely on a contract basis under departmental guidelines, and candidates cannot claim regular appointment.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years as of 01.01.2026, with an 11-year relaxation in the upper age limit.
